issues.suggestedFix: Give the glyph div an explicit lineHeight:1 (or fontFamily matching the original fallback) so it lands at the original y; optional, cosmetic.

issues.problem: The header says Vazirmatn is chosen for 'future text', but there is no text, so FaRoot only adds the font-metric shift above. The <FaRoot> children are not re-indented, and the Chinese comments are kept.

notes: Diffed against upstream: durations, timings, easing, seeds, N/HUES/GLYPHS, 34px/8deg steps, perspective and transform-origin are unchanged.
